title: What is bananascaler?
description: Start with the README to understand the product: a GPU-accelerated neural video upscaler that drives Real-ESRGAN and FFmpeg, with a live Bubbletea dashboard.

title: Binary entry point
description: main.go is a thin entry that delegates to the Cobra root command. All CLI flags, subcommands, and TUI launch flow start here.

title: Hardware-aware profiles
description: Before upscaling, the tool detects NVIDIA GPUs and selects a hardware tier and preset so VRAM limits and quality tradeoffs stay safe.

title: Core processing pipeline
description: The pipeline package orchestrates frame extraction, Real-ESRGAN per-frame upscaling, re-encoding, and audio mux — the heart of every job.

title: Interactive TUI dashboard
description: When run in a terminal, Bubbletea renders progress, stages, and logs. The model and pipeline adapter bridge UI events to the pipeline.

title: Build, test, and CI
description: Makefile and go.mod define local builds; GitHub Actions builds and tests every push to main so regressions are caught early.
